note_en: 一方面 A，另一方面 B works like English "on the one hand... on the other hand": 一方面他觉得手机确实方便…另一方面他又担心年轻人花太多时间在屏幕上 "on the one hand he finds the phone really convenient... on the other, he worries young people spend too much time on screens." Unlike 虽然…但是…, it doesn't set reality against expectation; it simply lays two equal sides of the same situation side by side, often with 又 or 还 in the second half.
